The petitioner is before this Court calling in question an order of the concerned court dated 09-09-2025 which cancels the bail granted to the petitioner on the score that, on being set at liberty he has threatened the victim.

2. Heard Miss Rakshitha Petition Singh, learned counsel appearing for petitioner and Sri K Nageshwarappa, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1.
NC: 2026:KHC:6803 HC-KAR 3.
To test the veracity of the statement of the victim, this Court had directed the victim to be examined before the concerned Court.

The order dated 23-01-2026 passed by this Court reads as follows:
"Learned counsel for petitioner submits that the concerned Court has cancelled the bail that is granted to the petitioner on the score that a complaint is registered by the Sri. Naveen Kumar G vs State Of Karnataka on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106857422/
2 victim alleging that the petitioner has threatened the victim.

sentences.text: Learned

Additional State Public Prosecutor submits that the crime has been registered on such threatening the victim by the petitioner and the police after investigation have filed a charge sheet in that case.
In the light of the filing of the charge sheet, it becomes necessary to notice whether there is real time threat to the victim by the petitioner.

Therefore, in the peculiar facts of this case, I deem it appropriate to direct the learned Magistrate to record the statement of the victim in C.C.No.7246/2024, and place it before the Court on the next date of hearing.
The statement of the victim shall be recorded on 30.01.2026.
List this matter on 05.02.2026.

A carbon copy of this order shall be furnished to the learned Additional State Public Prosecutor, forthwith."
The victim then appears before the concerned Court and the concerned Court has recorded the statement on 29-01-2026.
The victim narrates as to how she was threatened by rendering graphic details.
If this be the conduct of the petitioner, no fault NC: 2026:KHC:6803 HC-KAR can be found with the cancellation of bail.

However, the learned counsel submits that the concerned Court be directed to conclude the proceedings within a time limit, as the issue revolves around the petitioner and the victim being in love and the offence under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 having sprung.

Petition stands disposed accordingly.
Consequently, I.A.No.1 of 2026 also stands disposed.
